propositions: transport.py reached 799/800 LOC limit, blocking further parent-related changes and forcing repeated rescue splits that do not address root cause
Previous reactive splits (retry.py, transitions.py) did not establish clear homes for new operations, causing code to always default back to the god file

Re-architecting along capability seams (Protocol boundaries in _backend.py) aligns file organization with the class contract, so new operations have a determined home based on which capability they implement
Mixin-based composition preserves single JiraDataCenterTransport class, Protocol conformance, isinstance checks, and caller/test compatibility without behavior changes
Split produces five modules (_base, _issues, _people, _hierarchy, _links) each 100–500 LOC, eliminating the growth cycle while keeping shared cache and _call_logged wrapper intact
Epic-link field resolution (_resolve_epic_link_field_id) must have exactly one definition across the split to avoid reintroducing duplication that prior work (9bb9) fixed
